note: The app's feature switches. GET /v1/app/config answers features: {key: bool}; a key the answer leaves out takes its default here, which is bundled into both apps by web/scripts/gen-mobile-features.mjs. A feature lane ships dark (default false) and the API turns it on in both apps at once.
